+name: gui-execution

+description: Execute an explicitly authorized Windows GUI task through the connected external-API Runtime route, preserve original request and evidence identities, handle review without replaying input, and verify owned-window and host cleanup.
+## English
+Read `references/runtime.md` before using the connected Runtime. Discover its
+actual tools and schemas; Pi names may be namespaced or hashed, so never invent
+a tool name. This Skill supplies no tools, authority, executor, learning mode or
+shell route. Connector 0.0.8 supplies installation and execution guidance;
+publication, independent store approval and installed GUI execution are separate
+results. Historical 0.0.4/0.1.6 controlled Pi evidence is a separate result.
+Use only the existing external API route. Recommend separately installed
+Runtime 0.1.11; minimum 0.1.6 supplies the HTTP/pre-action contract, and the active
+service must supply field review/continue. Runtime 0.1.5 has no HTTP entry point.
+Runtime 0.1.7 current-Agent mode is not qualified through Amadeus here. Manually
+check MCP initialization version, actual tools/schemas, authentication and
+review/cleanup capabilities; neither a version number nor a later release
+establishes compatibility. The 0.1.6 protocol floor does not qualify all later
+0.1.x versions. No automatic compatibility detector is provided.
+Runtime 0.1.11 also fixes release of an initialized HTTP owner before any
+Runtime start attempt. DELETE can accept `cleanup_verified=false` only when the
+server's lifecycle evidence proves no start attempt, attached resources or
+pending work. Initial phase or `host_alive=false` alone is insufficient. Any
+attempted/failed start, active or unknown work, or unverified cleanup must follow
+the existing cleanup gate; the `cleanup_verified=true` path is unchanged. This
+exception releases an unused transport owner, not a task or recovery workflow.
+Do not start/stop a host or invoke recovery merely to make an unused owner
+releasable.
+Keep one Runtime MCP connection and one input owner for the complete authorized
+Work. The operator independently installs and starts the authenticated loopback
+daemon. The connector never launches Python, chooses executable paths, supplies
+provider keys or changes profiles. The local connection token is not a model
+API key. Screenshots/task information can reach the configured model services,
+whose calls may cost money. Confirm task scope and Runtime input opt-in:
+`--allow-local-input` enables input and turns automatic risk interception off.
+Start the host once, wait for ready, launch/select the intended window, use
+current bound observations, submit the task and inspect original receipts. A
+launch or asynchronous acknowledgement is not task success. Prepare known
+independent fields together and read healthy pending batches promptly; do not
+insert unrelated searches or documentation between them.
+For pending, unknown, timeout, interrupted input or unavailable images, retain
+original request/run/command IDs and inspect their state. Never replay possibly
+executed input under a new ID or resubmit to extend a wait. At a genuine
+`pre_action_review_packet.v1` or `field_review_packet.v1`, read
+`agent_command_status` with `command_id=packet.execution_request_id` under a new
+outer request ID and `images=none`. Retrieve that status request's bound image with
+`instant_image`: `view=before` for a candidate, `view=after` for entered text.
+Inspect the exact bound evidence against the task, copy
+`caller_controls.review.request` and add only the actual verdict/reason. Then
+separately use the returned continue recipe. Review alone performs no input.
+Pre-action continuation retains the original job/candidate and requires a fresh
+target-region check and existing hard gates before one dispatch. Field
+continuation does not retype; any submit suffix still needs normal gates and
+verification. With no genuine resumable ticket or a stale candidate, stop and
+report. Do not manufacture hashes, wait IDs, success or a restart/replay.
+Cancellation must settle to a real terminal state; a disconnect is not
+cancellation or cleanup. Close only task-launched windows using their returned
+handle/process identity, resolve save dialogs only for an authorized choice,
+and verify `window_closed`. Keep pre-existing/operator-prepared windows unless
+their closure is explicitly in scope. Call `instant_stop`, then poll until
+`host_alive=false`, `pending_ids=[]`, `cleanup_verified=true` and no unresolved
+cleanup error. Only then release the native HTTP owner. If an old owner is
+unresolved, inspect its original receipts and cleanup diagnostics. If the
+original connection is lost, retain evidence and stop for operator recovery.
+After Pi disconnects or encounters an owner conflict, both
+`instant_recovery_preview` and `instant_recover_session` are operator-only;
+Pi must not use them to take over the old session or workflow. Main's
+bound-image review/continue path in the original live session remains available
+under its existing contracts. Do not steal ownership, repeatedly
+reconnect/restart, or delete queues, locks or session records. Report task
+outcome separately from cleanup. Runtime 0.1.10 adds settlement of proven
+rejected `task_plan` controls and successful `observe` requests. Rejections
+require original durable before-dispatch proof; error strings alone are
+insufficient. Successful observation requires bound original capture and ledger
+evidence. Settlement of `recover` and `resume_pre_dispatch` remains unqualified.
+Consult the [settlement recovery guide](https://github.com/Desolate-Jix/agent-gui-runtime/blob/instant-v0.1.11/docs/RUNTIME_018_SETTLEMENT_RECOVERY.md)
+for retained evidence and the maintained operator entry point.
+Disabling/removing the connector releases the Host connection only; it does
+not stop/uninstall the independently running Runtime or delete its data. Finish
+cleanup before disabling/removing. Connector 0.0.8 updates guidance and metadata;
+Runtime fixes are delivered separately. 0.0.3/0.0.4/0.0.5/0.0.6/0.0.7 connection settings
+need no migration and input gates and permissions do not change.
+## 简体中文
+使用连接的 Runtime 前先读 `references/runtime.md`。发现实际工具与 schema；Pi 名称可能带命名空间或哈希，不能猜工具名。本 Skill 不提供工具、授权、执行器、学习模式或 shell 路线。连接器 0.0.8 提供安装与执行指引；作者发布、独立商店批准及安装态 GUI 执行分别记录。历史 0.0.4／0.1.6 受控 Pi 证据单独记录。

+仅使用原有 external API 路线。推荐独立安装的 Runtime 0.1.11；最低 0.1.6 提供 HTTP／输入前审核合同，活动服务还须提供文字结果审核／继续。Runtime 0.1.5 没有 HTTP 入口。此处没有通过 Amadeus 核验 Runtime 0.1.7 current-Agent 模式。人工核对 MCP 初始化版本、实际工具／schema、鉴权及审核／清理能力；版本号或后续发行不能证明兼容。0.1.6 的协议起点不表示所有后续 0.1.x 版本均已具备资格。本包不提供自动兼容探测器。

+Runtime 0.1.11 另修复从未尝试启动 Runtime 的已初始化 HTTP 所有者无法释放的问题。仅当服务端生命周期证据证明从未尝试 start、未附着资源且无 pending 时，DELETE 才允许 `cleanup_verified=false`；仅有初始 phase 或 `host_alive=false` 不足以放行。已尝试／失败的启动、活动或未知工作、未核验清理仍走原门禁，`cleanup_verified=true` 路线不变。这只释放未使用的传输所有者，不结算任务或恢复工作流；不要仅为释放未使用 owner 而启动／停止宿主或调用恢复。

+完整授权 Work 保持一个 Runtime MCP 连接和一个输入所有者。操作员独立安装并启动带鉴权的本机 daemon；连接器不会启动 Python、选择可执行路径、提供模型密钥或改 profile。本机连接密钥不是模型 API Key。截图／任务信息可能发送给已配置模型服务，服务调用可能收费。确认任务范围及 Runtime 输入授权：`--allow-local-input` 启用输入，同时关闭自动风险拦截。宿主只启动一次，等待 ready，启动／选择目标窗口，使用当前绑定观察，提交任务并检查原回执。启动或异步确认不是任务成功。已知独立字段提前合并准备，及时读取正常待定批次，不在其间插入无关搜索或文档工作。

+待定、未知、超时、中断输入或图像不可用时，保留原 request／run／command ID 并检查状态。可能执行过的输入不能换 ID 重放，也不能为延长等待而重交。真实 `pre_action_review_packet.v1` 或 `field_review_packet.v1` 出现时，用新外层 request ID 和 `images=none` 调用 `agent_command_status`，`command_id=packet.execution_request_id`。随后用 `instant_image` 取该状态请求绑定图像：候选看 `view=before`，已输入文字看 `view=after`。对照任务检查确切绑定证据，复制 `caller_controls.review.request`，仅添加实际 verdict／reason，再单独使用返回的 continue recipe。审核本身不输入。前置继续保留原 job／候选，派发一次前须通过新截图的目标区域核对及既有硬门禁；文字结果继续不重输，后续 submit 仍须普通门禁及核验。没有真实可续票据或候选已过期就停报。不伪造哈希、wait ID、成功或重启／重放。

+取消须结算到真实终态；断线不等于取消或清理。仅按返回 handle／process 身份关闭本任务启动的窗口，仅处理已授权选择的保存对话框，并核对 `window_closed`。保留原有／操作员预备窗口，除非其关闭已明确纳入任务。调用 `instant_stop`，查询至 `host_alive=false`、`pending_ids=[]`、`cleanup_verified=true` 且没有未解决清理错误，之后才释放原生 HTTP 所有者。旧所有者未结算时读取原回执和清理诊断；原连接丢失时保留证据并停止，交操作员恢复。Pi 断线或遇到 owner 冲突后，`instant_recovery_preview`、`instant_recover_session` 两个工具仅限操作员使用，Pi 不得用它们接管旧会话或工作流。原活动会话中 Main 对绑定图像审核／继续的路径仍按既有合同保留。不抢占、不反复重连／重启、不删除队列、锁或会话记录。任务结果与清理分别报告。Runtime 0.1.10 新增证据完整的拒绝 `task_plan` 控制及成功 `observe` 请求的结算；拒绝须有原始持久化派发前证明，错误字符串本身不足为据，成功观察须有绑定的原截图及账本证据。`recover`、`resume_pre_dispatch` 的结算仍未具备资格。保留证据及正式维护的操作员入口见[结算恢复指南](https://github.com/Desolate-Jix/agent-gui-runtime/blob/instant-v0.1.11/docs/RUNTIME_018_SETTLEMENT_RECOVERY.md)。
+禁用／移除连接器只释放 Host 连接，不停止／卸载独立运行的 Runtime，也不删除它的数据。先完成清理再禁用／移除。连接器 0.0.8 更新指引与元数据，Runtime 修复单独交付；0.0.3／0.0.4／0.0.5／0.0.6／0.0.7 连接设置无需迁移，输入门禁及权限不变。
+# Runtime session and receipt contract / 会话与回执合同
+## Prerequisites / 使用前提
+This resource connector uses an independently installed, operator-started,
+authenticated Windows loopback HTTP MCP Runtime. It never launches external
+code. The local connection token is distinct from provider API keys. This
+Skill supports the existing external API route only; configured model services
+receive recognition/review screenshots and task information and may charge for
+calls. Input requires explicit task authorization and Runtime opt-in;
+`--allow-local-input` also turns automatic risk interception off. Do not change
+profiles, thresholds or prompts to bypass a refusal.

+本资源连接器使用用户独立安装并启动、带鉴权的 Windows 本机 HTTP MCP Runtime，不会启动外部代码。本机连接密钥与模型 API Key 不同。本 Skill 仅支持原有 external API 路线；已配置模型服务会接收识别／审核截图及任务信息，可能按调用收费。输入须有明确任务授权及 Runtime opt-in；`--allow-local-input` 也会关闭自动风险拦截。不能改 profile、阈值或提示词来绕过拒绝。
+Recommend Runtime 0.1.11. The minimum HTTP/pre-action contract is 0.1.6;
+the service must also supply field-review/continue. Runtime 0.1.5 has field
+review but no HTTP entry point. This connector does not qualify Runtime 0.1.7
+current-Agent mode through Amadeus. Manually inspect the MCP initialization
+version, authentication, discovered tools and active schemas before input:
+`instant_start`, `instant_status`, `instant_run`, `instant_result`,
+`instant_image`, `instant_stop`, and task-plan/original-command status and
+review/continue support. Logical names below are Runtime names, not guesses
+about Pi's namespaced/hashed tool names. Neither a version marker nor a later
+release proves compatibility; no automatic compatibility detector is provided.
+The 0.1.6 protocol floor does not qualify every later 0.1.x version; use
+validation evidence for the exact Runtime/connector versions and route.

+推荐 Runtime 0.1.11。最低 HTTP／前置审核合同为 0.1.6，服务还须提供文字结果审核／继续。Runtime 0.1.5 有文字审核但没有 HTTP 入口。本连接器没有通过 Amadeus 核验 Runtime 0.1.7 current-Agent 模式。输入前人工检查 MCP 初始化版本、鉴权、已发现工具及活动 schema：`instant_start`、`instant_status`、`instant_run`、`instant_result`、`instant_image`、`instant_stop`，以及 task-plan／原命令状态和审核／继续支持。下文逻辑名称是 Runtime 名称，不能据此猜 Pi 带命名空间／哈希的工具名。版本号或后续发行不能证明兼容，本包没有自动兼容探测器。0.1.6 的协议起点不表示所有后续 0.1.x 版本均已具备资格；须按确切 Runtime／连接器版本及路线的验证证据判断。
+## Never-started HTTP owner / 未启动 HTTP 所有者
+Runtime 0.1.11 also fixes release of an initialized HTTP owner before any
+Runtime start attempt. DELETE can accept `cleanup_verified=false` only when the
+server's lifecycle evidence proves no start attempt, attached resources or
+pending work. Initial phase or `host_alive=false` alone is insufficient. Any
+attempted/failed start, active or unknown work, or unverified cleanup must follow
+the existing cleanup gate; the `cleanup_verified=true` path is unchanged. This
+exception releases an unused transport owner, not a task or recovery workflow.
+Do not start/stop a host or invoke recovery merely to make an unused owner
+releasable.

+Runtime 0.1.11 另修复从未尝试启动 Runtime 的已初始化 HTTP 所有者无法释放的问题。仅当服务端生命周期证据证明从未尝试 start、未附着资源且无 pending 时，DELETE 才允许 `cleanup_verified=false`；仅有初始 phase 或 `host_alive=false` 不足以放行。已尝试／失败的启动、活动或未知工作、未核验清理仍走原门禁，`cleanup_verified=true` 路线不变。这只释放未使用的传输所有者，不结算任务或恢复工作流；不要仅为释放未使用 owner 而启动／停止宿主或调用恢复。
+## Start and select / 启动与选择
+Keep one live MCP connection and one input owner for the entire Work. Call the
+discovered `instant_start` once, then `instant_status` until ready. Vision and
+Decision profiles are preconfigured; do not call `prepare_models` or
+`learning_*`. A selected target is session state. Prepare known independent
+fields together, read healthy pending results promptly, and do not insert
+unrelated searches/documentation between action batches.

+完整 Work 保持一个活动 MCP 连接和一个输入所有者。发现实际工具后，只调用一次 `instant_start`，再查询 `instant_status` 至 ready。视觉与 Decision profile 已事先配置，不调用 `prepare_models` 或 `learning_*`。选中目标属于会话状态。已知独立字段合并准备，及时读取正常待定结果，不在动作批次间插入无关搜索／文档工作。
+For a new application/shortcut explicitly in scope, use the actual approved
+path. Read its returned ownership and exact handle/process_id. Example:
+对于明确纳入任务的新应用／快捷方式，使用实际已授权路径，读取返回的归属及确切 handle／process_id。例如：
+```json
+{"request_id":"launch-001","command":{"kind":"launch","path":"C:\\approved-test\\application.lnk","prefer_existing":false},"wait_ms":10000,"images":"none"}
+For an observed existing window, select its real identities with the shape
+`{"kind":"select","handle":123,"process_id":456}`. Example integers are
+placeholders, not targets. A pre-existing/operator-prepared window does not
+become task-owned. Capture the selected target with **only** `kind`:
+对于已观察到的现有窗口，按 `{"kind":"select","handle":123,"process_id":456}` 形状填真实身份。示例整数只是占位符，不是目标。现有／操作员预备窗口不会变成本任务自有窗口。捕获已选目标时，command **只放** `kind`：
+```json
+{"request_id":"capture-001","command":{"kind":"capture"},"wait_ms":10000,"images":"after"}
+Do not put handle/process_id in `capture`. Use the original images bound to
+`instant_run`/`instant_result`; `instant_image` retrieves available images by
+the original request ID. A new capture is a new observation, not replacement
+evidence for an older action. Never mix old coordinates with current geometry.
+Pi may natively resize a complete bound frame for its model; do not claim that
+this is byte-identical original PNG delivery.
+`capture` 不放 handle／process_id。使用 `instant_run`／`instant_result` 绑定的原图，`instant_image` 按原 request ID 取可用图像。新 capture 是新观察，不能替换旧动作证据。不把旧坐标与当前几何混用。Pi 可能原生缩放完整绑定帧再交给模型，不能声称这等于原 PNG 字节相同交付。
+## Submit, wait and inspect / 提交、等待与核对
+Use a complete `task_plan` when the task calls for one; do not split it to evade
+checks. Follow the actual schema, explicit actions/verification and original
+run identity. There is no connector step cap; Runtime budgets, evidence binding
+and admission apply. `instant_run` accepts `request_id`, `command`, `wait_ms`,
+`detail` and `images`; keep receipt waits below the MCP client timeout. A
+running start receipt or asynchronous `instant_submit` acknowledgement is not
+completion. When pending, follow returned `next` and read `instant_result`
+with the **same** outer request ID:

+任务需要完整 `task_plan` 时按实际 schema 使用，不拆分来规避检查。保留明确动作／核验及原 run 身份。连接器没有步数上限，Runtime 预算、证据绑定与准入仍适用。`instant_run` 接收 `request_id`、`command`、`wait_ms`、`detail`、`images`，回执等待须低于 MCP 客户端超时。running 启动回执或异步 `instant_submit` 确认不是完成。待定时按返回 `next`，用**相同**外层 request ID 读取 `instant_result`：
+```json
+{"request_id":"launch-001","detail":"full","images":"both"}
+For `agent_command.v1`, retain command_id. Read its state under a new outer
+request ID; this read-only status request is not a replay. For a review packet,
+its `execution_request_id` is the command_id to query. The example value must
+be replaced by the real original identity:
+对于 `agent_command.v1`，保留 command_id；用新外层 request ID 读状态，这是只读状态请求，不是重放。审核 packet 的 `execution_request_id` 就是要查询的 command_id；示例值须替换为真实原身份：
+```json
+{"request_id":"status-001","command":{"kind":"agent_command_status","request":{"command_id":"original-execution-request-id"}},"wait_ms":10000,"images":"none"}
+Inspect `instant_status.task_plan_run` and original start/result receipts until
+a terminal outcome or explicit wait. Report completed steps, pending/review/
+failure and bound evidence, not merely tool success. `result_unknown`, timeout,
+`action_executed=true`, interrupted typing or a missing after image never prove
+input did not happen. Preserve original request/run/command IDs; do not resend
+input to extend a wait, start a competing plan or use another input route to
+hide uncertainty. Cancellation must reach its real terminal state.

+检查 `instant_status.task_plan_run` 及原启动／结果回执，直到终态或明确等待。报告完成步骤、待定／审核／失败与绑定证据，不能只报工具成功。`result_unknown`、超时、`action_executed=true`、输入中断或缺少后图不能证明未输入。保留原 request／run／command ID，不重交输入延长等待、不另起竞争计划、不用其他输入路线掩盖未知。取消须到真实终态。
+## Main review / 原 Agent 审核
+Use the actual packet returned by the active service. A candidate before input

+## Start the local Runtime
+Install the Runtime first. Install `uv` if setup requests it. Copy
+`configs/vision-api-openai-luna.example.json` and
+`configs/decision-profile.visual-execution.example.json` to private profile
+files, then configure endpoints, models and task conditions according to the
+Runtime guide. Keep Decision thresholds and ordinary-review policy explicit.
+Screenshots and task information used for recognition/review are sent to the
+selected model services. Those services may charge for calls; this wheel
+includes no model service or API credit. Set each profile's `api_key_env` only
+in the Runtime process environment. The examples use `OPENAI_API_KEY`; never
+put a provider key in connector settings.
+Generate and privately store a strong random URL-safe **local connection
+token** of 32–256 characters (for example, using `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` in
+your trusted Python environment). It is distinct from every model-provider API
+key. Prompt for secrets without echoing them, then start the service in a
+dedicated console:
+```powershell
+$RuntimeRoot = 'C:\Path\To\Runtime'
+$RuntimeData = 'C:\Path\To\GuiRuntimeData'
+$VisionProfile = 'C:\Path\To\Config\vision-api.json'
+$DecisionProfile = 'C:\Path\To\Config\decision.json'
+$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = [System.Net.NetworkCredential]::new('', (Read-Host 'Provider API key' -AsSecureString)).Password
+$env:AGENT_GUI_MCP_TOKEN = [System.Net.NetworkCredential]::new('', (Read-Host 'Local MCP connection token' -AsSecureString)).Password
+Set-Location -LiteralPath $RuntimeRoot
+& '.\scripts\setup_instant.ps1' -RecognitionSource external_api -ApiProfile $VisionProfile -DataDirectory $RuntimeData
+& '.\.venv-agent\Scripts\python.exe' -I -B -X utf8 scripts/start_instant_mcp_http.py `
+  --data-dir $RuntimeData --port 17665 --recognition-source external_api `
+  --api-profile $VisionProfile --decision-profile $DecisionProfile
+Run setup once; it may download locked dependencies. Its generated standalone
+stdio MCP configuration is not needed for this connector. Omit `-PythonVersion`
+to retain an existing supported API environment. An explicit different minor
+version requires a separate environment rather than an in-place replacement.
+Keep this console open while Amadeus uses the service.
+Input is disabled by default. For an explicitly authorized desktop task, append
+the existing `--allow-local-input` option to the final startup command. **This
+option also turns automatic risk interception off.** A token authenticates the
+connection; it does not authorize arbitrary clicks, submissions, payments or
+unrelated file changes. The service binds only `127.0.0.1`, validates Host and
+rejects browser Origin headers before MCP processing. Do not expose it through
+a public bind, tunnel or reverse proxy.

+3. Set `runtime_url` to `http://127.0.0.1:17665/mcp`, or the port you selected.

+4. Bind both MCP and Skill to Pi, explicitly enable, apply the backend restart,

+5. Inspect the MCP initialization version and discovered tools, then read

+Acceptance requires four successful original navigation steps, bound image
+evidence of the final path, an unchanged fixture tree and verified host cleanup.
+Report any Main review or assistance. Do not count launch acknowledgements,
+pending receipts or an uninspected screenshot as success. No external data write
+is authorized; the fixture is created manually beforehand. It is a
+navigation example, not compression/extraction or a performance benchmark.
+## Task, review and cleanup

+Use the packaged [Skill](https://github.com/Desolate-Jix/agent-gui-runtime/blob/amadeus-extension-v0.0.8/integrations/amadeus/agent-review-instant/src/amadeus_agent_gui/skills/gui-execution/SKILL.md)

+and [reference](https://github.com/Desolate-Jix/agent-gui-runtime/blob/amadeus-extension-v0.0.8/integrations/amadeus/agent-review-instant/src/amadeus_agent_gui/skills/gui-execution/references/runtime.md).
+Keep one MCP connection and one input owner for the whole Work. Pending,
+unknown or interrupted input keeps its original request/run/command IDs; never
+replay it with a new ID to extend a wait.
+At a genuine `pre_action_review_packet.v1`, read the original job through a new
+status request, inspect that status request's bound **before** image, then copy
+the returned review recipe and use its separately returned continue recipe.
+Review itself does not click. Continuation retains the original job/candidate
+and must pass a fresh target-region check and existing input gates before one
+dispatch. At `field_review_packet.v1`, inspect the bound **after** image of the
+already-entered text; continuation does not retype. A field review does not
+approve a candidate or prove a later submission succeeded. Without a genuine
+resumable ticket, or with stale evidence, stop and report the original state.
+Historical Pi evidence used a natively resized complete bound frame, not
+byte-identical original PNG delivery. The controlled, assisted 0.0.4/0.1.6
+tests establish their stated recovery scope, not unattended accuracy, speed or
+new-combination acceptance.
+Close only task-launched windows using their returned identities, and verify
+`window_closed`; retain an operator-prepared window as in the example above.
+Then call `instant_stop` and poll until `host_alive=false`, `pending_ids=[]` and
+`cleanup_verified=true`. Only then release the HTTP MCP owner so another Work
+can connect. A disconnect is not cancellation or cleanup. Disabling/removing
+the connector changes its Host-side connection configuration; backend changes
+follow the Host's restart requirements. It does not stop or uninstall the external
+Runtime or delete its data. Finish cleanup before disabling/removing;
+stop the independent service deliberately afterward if desired.
+## Troubleshooting and recovery
+| Symptom | What to check and do |

+| Connection refused, timeout or no tools | Confirm the Runtime console is still running, setup succeeded, and `runtime_url` uses the actual loopback port and `/mcp`. Start the service with the command above if it was never started. Do not launch a second copy while another owner/input is unresolved. |

+| HTTP 401 / `authentication_required` | The two local tokens must match. Enter the local token in secret `connection_token`; a provider API key is wrong here. Do not paste secrets into logs. If the daemon token must change, first settle the old task and cleanup, then restart deliberately and reconnect. |

+| HTTP 404, 421 or 403 | Use `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp` directly through Amadeus's native MCP client. Check the endpoint/port; remove any proxy or browser route. The server rejects invalid Host or browser Origin headers. |

+| Missing HTTP, tools, schema or review/continue recipe | Manually check the installed and MCP-reported Runtime version and actual schemas. 0.1.5 cannot serve this connector. For an unsupported contract, stop before new input; after settling any old owner, install/configure the recommended Runtime separately and recheck. Never invent a ticket or assume a later version is compatible. |

+| Input disabled or model/profile error | Confirm the private API/Decision profiles and their environment-variable names in the Runtime console. Enable `--allow-local-input` only for an authorized task, remembering that it turns automatic risk interception off. Do not change thresholds/prompts to force a pass; settle the current task before restarting configuration. |

+| Cancel requested, timeout or disconnect during input | Preserve original IDs and inspect original status/results. Cancellation is not terminal until confirmed. If the original live connection remains usable, follow its actual cancel/status recipe and wait for settlement, then clean up. If it is lost, preserve diagnostics and stop for operator recovery; a new Work is not the old MCP owner. Never replay unknown input. |

+| `input_owner_conflict`, `runtime_cleanup_required` or old owner not released | Return to the original live Work, settle pending receipts, close its owned windows, call `instant_stop`, verify all cleanup conditions and release that native session. Inspect `cleanup_pending` diagnostics and resolve the specific blocker before retrying cleanup only. If the original owner is unavailable, retain evidence and obtain Runtime maintenance help. Do not steal ownership, delete queues/locks/session records or repeatedly reconnect/restart to bypass the gate. |
+After Pi disconnects or reports an owner conflict, both
+`instant_recovery_preview` and `instant_recover_session` remain **operator-only**;
+Pi must not call them to take over the old session or continue its workflow.
+This restriction does not remove Main's bound-image review/continue path in
+the original live session: that path retains the original job and existing
+input gates. For settlement diagnostics and migration from Runtime 0.1.8, see
+the [Runtime settlement recovery guide](https://github.com/Desolate-Jix/agent-gui-runtime/blob/instant-v0.1.11/docs/RUNTIME_018_SETTLEMENT_RECOVERY.md).
+Runtime 0.1.11 also fixes release of an initialized HTTP owner before any
+Runtime start attempt. DELETE can accept `cleanup_verified=false` only when the
+server's lifecycle evidence proves no start attempt, attached resources or
+pending work. Initial phase or `host_alive=false` alone is insufficient. Any
+attempted/failed start, active or unknown work, or unverified cleanup must follow
+the existing cleanup gate; the `cleanup_verified=true` path is unchanged. This
+exception releases an unused transport owner, not a task or recovery workflow.
+Do not start/stop a host or invoke recovery merely to make an unused owner
+releasable.
+Runtime 0.1.10 extends `task_plan` input-settlement validation to proven rejected
+control requests and successful `observe` requests. A rejection must have its
+original durable before-dispatch proof; an error string alone does not prove
+zero input. Successful observation must bind the original capture and ledger
+evidence. `recover` and `resume_pre_dispatch` settlement remain unqualified;
+this release does not claim support for them. Follow the guide to verify
+retained evidence through the maintained settlement entry point.
+Keep original evidence; an unknown settlement is not proof that no input ran.
